You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Dev, Ben, Fay, Ada, Cal, Eli. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 2 and 6 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Proposal: everyone claims a modest, equal amount today (I'm claiming 2) so the storehouse doesn't get over-claimed and rations are shared out evenly. Anyone who ends up holding more than they need tonight should give the extra to whoever has none, so that as many of us as possible survive. Please reply with your claims and holdings each morning.
